items.title: Joseph "Red" Clark Interview, 1959-01-13
items.q: And Felix Goff, he was on the clarinet and had another boy on the E flat clarinet called Stewart... And we just kept on with that little band like that so funny.

ctx.x: And Felix Goff, he was on the clarinet and had another boy on the E flat clarinet called Stewart. I don't know what happened to him. He went out of the picture all at once, I don't know.
